values.note: Book online (Let's Camp); seasonal sites by phone. Paid in full at booking; stays of a week or less need 48 hours' notice to cancel, and long-weekend bookings in May, July and August are not refundable.

note: Regional park 3 km south of Yorkton on York Lake: beach, canoe and kayak rentals, a nature trail, ball diamonds, trap and archery ranges, and a canteen. The daily sites are in the treed CJ Houston loop; the 50 A rows north of it are seasonal. A 12-hole golf course is about 2 km away. --Claude
summary: Keep (regional park). 58 sites: Let's Camp sells 26 daily RV (30 A + water, 7 with sewer, maxRV 32-40) + 6 tent nightly (~55%); 27 seasonal (7 x 30 A FS, 20 x 50 A). C$33 + GST (2024 table), entry C$8. Sites 38 -> 58; sewer added. Season May 15 - Oct 10 kept. Not waterfront kept. Pin OK.
flags: LONG-STAY (local): 30 of ~57 sites (26 daily RV + 6 tent, excl. the group site) are nightly (~53%) - over half, so no mostly-seasonal caveat. Nightly rate posted, online booking. Google Maps 'York Lake Regional Park - Campground' 4.1 (16 reviews).
SITES: stored 38 (derived) -> 58 (Let's Camp bio: 19 + 5 daily, 6 tent, 7 + 20 seasonal, 1 group). The stored note's '31 daily sites' is not what Let's Camp lists (26 daily RV).
HOOKUPS: sewer added (7 daily sewer sites); electric 30 kept (50 A seasonal only).
FEES: the only posted daily rate is the 2024 regional-parks table (C$33 + GST); Let's Camp posts nothing off-season.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept - Esri z18: the CJ Houston loop (~51.1658,-102.4893) and the seasonal rows (~51.1665,-102.4920) sit 150+ m from York Lake behind a road, trees and the cottage lots along the shore.
PIN: stored 51.16550,-102.48950 is on the south edge of the CJ Houston daily loop. Keep. (Let's Camp 51.16384,-102.48993 is the day-use/beach area.)
